desc: 藕粉拱龛与米绒白卡场里的女士三角裤体系，含里裆细节与四色宫格
leaf: 女士柔糯无痕中低腰三角内裤
name: 柔糯无痕女士中低腰三角内裤款

shots.intent: 用拱形壁龛与圆台悬浮把柔软贴身的中低腰三角版型一眼立住，建立整组的暖色记忆点
shots.textZone: 左上两行堆叠主标题位＋一行小写宽字距英文 sub-label＋一条细下划线，另留一行引导短句位

shots.intent: 把裤脚卷边、腰头拧绞与缝骨起皱这些日常贴身问题做成同机位上下对照，先戳痛点再给方案
shots.textZone: 整屏左上仅一行两字组主标题位，格内不填实词、不加箭头与标注

shots.intent: 用仰视同框的两件并列与三枚编号引线，讲清腰头织带、裤脚包边与侧缝位置三处结构差异
shots.textZone: 顶部三分之一一条标题位，三枚编号点旁各一个短标签空位（三格同长）

shots.intent: 在真实衣物与毛巾参照物之间给出可信尺度与收纳状态，把贴身衣物放进日常场景
shots.textZone: 上半屏一条主标题位＋一行引导短句位，格内不压产品

shots.intent: 微距放大宽腰头织带的罗纹走向与包边平整度，用可见做工替代任何口头承诺
正俯视翻开内里，用可见的双层里裆与缝份走向回答贴身层最关心的结构问题
用三枚圆形实物切片加一张空信息卡承载洗护与包装事实，以可见细节替代任何背书
shots.textZone: 每枚圆切片下方一个短标签位（三格同长），表格式四行留空，单元格一律不填

shots.intent: 2x2 圆角卡一次给出多个颜色选择并留出色名空槽，缩短选款决策路径
shots.textZone: 宫格上方一条标题带，每格下方一个色名空槽，槽内不填实词

shots.intent: 详情尾部收口，用同一拱龛尺度与一枚空按钮承接加购动作，首尾同色闭环
shots.textZone: 下五分之一按钮位一行短字，其余区域不放文字

style.backgroundSystem: one flat continuous warm field per screen and never two in one: dusty-rose seamless studio wall #E7CFC5 carrying a shallow arched niche recess for the hero and the close screen, deep terracotta-plum #7E4A45 full-bleed field for the pain-point split and the structural comparison, cream paper card field #FBF5EF for the two macro boards, the trust card and the four variant sub-panels, and a softly draped matte jersey surface in #E7CFC5 only inside the wardrobe scene screen; a real palm-frond shadow may fall across one frame edge on the scene and variant screens only; no gradient sky, no cool grey cyclorama, no tiered step stage, no curtain architecture, no glass dome
style.direction: warm soft-hand-feel women's intimates boutique commerce
style.iconSystem: no pictogram matrix and no capsule tags; graphic language is limited to three circular photo insets with a single hairline ring outline in #4A3138, small plain numbered dots 1-2-3 in #93A87E joined to the garment by one hairline leader line, the hairline underline rule, and one blank rounded rectangle button shape; no filled badges, no shields, no seals, no award or certification marks, no document frames
style.lightingSystem: warm soft studio light around 4500K, oversized diffused key from the upper left thrown through a sheer scrim, low-contrast wraparound fill card on the shadow side, one faint bounce card under the plinth line, long soft-edged shadows that always ground the garment, and a single controlled rim highlight travelling along the crown curve so the knit sheen reads; grazing light only inside the macro screens; no hard speculars, no blown highlights, no cold blue cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm soft-hand-feel women's intimates commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of dusty-rose seamless field #E7CFC5, cream paper card #FBF5EF, deep terracotta-plum information field #7E4A45, plum-brown ink #4A3138 and one sage-green hairline accent #93A87E; warm soft studio light around 4500K with an oversized diffused key from the upper left through a sheer scrim, a wraparound fill card, a faint bottom bounce, long soft-edged shadows that always ground the garment and one controlled rim highlight along the crown curve; shallow arched niche plus a matte ceramic round plinth disc with a thin brushed metal rim #C6A375 as the only set pieces, cream paper macro boards elsewhere, never a tiered step stage, never a glass dome; rounded humanist sans-serif for every rendered line with one lower-case wide-tracked English sub-label and a hairline underline rule; graphic language limited to circular photo insets with hairline ring outlines, small plain numbered dots with hairline leader lines and one blank rounded button shape, never an icon matrix, capsule tag, shield or seal; garment shown on a contourless invisible form, laid flat or in tight macro at a stable centre-weighted scale, waistband horizontal with its tape width unchanged, gusset lining shade kept, knit jersey rendered truthfully with sheen only along the crown curve; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched graphic styles, no model, no face, no invented certification, composition or size artwork.
noDrift: no palette changes outside the five locked hexes
no mixed fonts, no serif, script or handwritten lettering
no model, face, hands, limbs, torso or body contour in frame; contourless invisible form only
no posed, sexualised or crotch-focused human presentation
no fibre composition, percentage, cotton-origin, yarn count, weight or thread-count wording
no antibacterial, sterilising, anti-mite, anion, graphene, medical-grade or hygiene-therapy wording
no certification, test report, inspection seal, shield, award mark or standard number
no size chart values, measurements, size codes or body ranges
no slimming, lifting or body-shaping result claim
no tearing, snapping or pulled-to-distortion fabric demonstration
no invented percentages, ratings, sales counters or price, coupon, membership or QR artwork
no glass cloche, sealed jar or any sterilisation staging prop
style.presentationRules: three locked scales only: the garment held on a contourless invisible form with a soft contact shadow, the garment laid flat or folded on one plane, and the tight macro reading of one construction edge; identical front orientation and centre-weighted scale between screens, waistband kept horizontal with its tape width and rib direction unchanged, leg-cut and seam placement unchanged, gusset lining shade kept exactly as in the reference, fabric sheen kept as a fine uniform knit jersey with a low satin-like glow only along the crown curve and never rendered as woven, satin or mesh; no face, no hands, no limbs and no body contour ever enter the frame, and no screen mixes the invisible-form scale with the flat-lay scale
style.surfaceSystem: one matte ceramic round plinth disc with a thin brushed metal rim #C6A375 as the only stage piece, cream paper macro board #FBF5EF with a hairline bevel, undyed matte terry towel and one plain wooden hanger as real scale anchors inside the scene screen, no concrete, no marble veining, no polished metal sphere, no fluted column, no lacquered tiers
style.typography: rounded humanist sans-serif as the single family, one bold two-line stacked Chinese display headline plus one lower-case wide-tracked English sub-label as the only Latin line, one hairline underline rule under the headline, one short lead-in line, headline 26-42pt, lead-in and label 12-16pt, every rendered Chinese string comes from a selling_point or callout placeholder slot and never from source copy
